title: Notes from the roadmap
flipLabel: Turn the postcard over to read the message
message: Lately I’ve been using Clouisle’s Linear integration to stay on top of everything the Tools team is shipping and what needs my attention.

My go-to prompt at the top of the week is: “Visualize a table summarizing the status, health, and progress of every project in Linear on the Tools team this week, sorted by risk, and flag any whose status doesn’t match their actual issue activity.”
This brings to the forefront everything I need to check up on, and gives me a great overview of where the team is at.

issues.title: Notes from the roadmap
issues.description: A closer look at the work, decisions, and small details shaping the next release.
issues.greeting: A note from the security team
message: A question we work on constantly on the security team: how do you get the most out of Clouisle's AI without giving up control of your data?
Your chat history stays on your machine. When Clouisle sends relevant context to a model provider, it is handled under zero data retention, so nothing is persisted after the request.
With Clouisle, your history is yours: available when you need it, and never sitting in a third-party cloud.

issues.title: Clouisle connects to your network
issues.description: Bring the tools your team already uses into one focused workspace, with context ready when work begins.
message: Finding the best fit for our team is the heart of what I do, and lately Clouisle's LinkedIn integration has become my right hand.

I can ask Clouisle to surface candidates who share a connection with someone at our company and match what we're looking for. The right names appear instantly, so I can spend my time on people, not searching.

issues.title: Switch contexts in a swipe
issues.description: Move between workspaces without losing your place, your tabs, or the context behind the task at hand.
message: For those who have been waiting, they're finally here. For those who are newer to Clouisle, context switching just got a lot simpler.
Profiles keep your logins, your tools, your AI, and your context exactly where they belong. The missing piece was getting between them quickly, so we added a better way to switch.
To try it: create a new Profile, then swipe away. Your work stays right where you left it.
